Subject: Draft MSA + Order Form for Fluxa onboarding

Jonas — thanks again for the demo yesterday. Attaching the draft MSA and our initial order form so your team can start intake. High level asks from my side:

- Can you confirm if Redwood can accept Net 60 payment terms and provide a standard PO reference flow?
- We need a short list of subprocessors (SaaS vendors) used for hosted inference and where logs are stored (S3, region).
- Data residency: we prefer EU-only residency for PHI-related workloads — please call out whether your Hosted/Private options can be constrained.
- Insurance and liability: procurement will want to see proof of limits.

I've attached: fluxa_draft_msa_v1.docx and fluxa_orderform_20270514.xlsx and a preliminary PO template (fluxa_procurement_po.pdf). We're hoping to get an initial redline and a suggested decision list by EOD Monday so we can schedule a procurement review on Tuesday.

Would also like a quick call next week for contract alignment — Priya (procurement) will lead that side.

Thanks,
Avery Cole
Director of Platform Partnerships
Fluxa Health

Attachments: fluxa_draft_msa_v1.docx (contract draft), fluxa_orderform_20270514.xlsx (pricing/seat schedule), fluxa_procurement_po.pdf (PO template)

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Avery Cole <avery.cole@fluxahealth.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MSA + Order Form for Fluxa onboarding

Avery — thanks for sending these over and for the time yesterday. Looping in Legal (Kimberly, Soojin) and Contracts (Marissa) to intake the materials. Initial plan and asks from our side: 

1) We're going to produce a marked-up MSA (attached: jw_fluxa_msa_redlines_20270514.docx) that highlights high-priority items for commercial decisioning: indemnity, liability cap, data/residency appendix, and payment terms.
2) Procurement: Net 60 is outside our template default (Net 30) — Marissa, can you confirm whether Net 60 can be approved at sales/finance for a health customer and what concession, if any, would be needed (e.g., 1.25x price reserve)?
3) Security evidence: Fluxa asked for SOC 2 and subprocessor list. Soojin, can you prepare an evidence packet and the canonical subprocessor list (short-form) we can share under NDA?
4) Residency: our Hosted product supports region pinning but not strict EU-only isolation for model inference unless on Dedicated/Private. We should propose an Exhibit D (data residency addendum) or recommend Redwood Private (VPC) for EU PHI to avoid long-term compliance risk.

Decision log (what we need from Fluxa in the next 48 hours):
- Confirm procurement lead and requested payment terms (Priya?);
- Indicate whether Fluxa will accept mutual indemnity or requests unilateral language;
- Confirm expected seats and anticipated Q3 ramp (this impacts orderform tiers).

Internal next steps: Kim/So are you ok to review the attached and return initial legal comments by EOD Monday? Marissa — I’ll sync with Finance once we have a recommended terms concession for Net 60.

Proposed contract kickoff: Tue 18 May at 10:00 PT — please confirm availability.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Head of GTM Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment: jw_fluxa_msa_redlines_20270514.docx (initial redline — commercial flags in red comments)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Draft MSA + Order Form for Fluxa onboarding

Jonas / team — quick initial legal take after a first pass (attachment: km_fluxa_initial_comments.pdf). High-level items to flag for commercial discussion: 

- Indemnity / IP carveouts: Fluxa's draft is vendor-unfriendly on indemnity for third-party claims related to clinical outcomes. We should push for mutual indemnity with a carveout limited to Redwood's gross negligence or willful misconduct.
- Liability cap: their proposed unlimited liability for data breaches is non-starter. Recommend a negotiated cap tied to 12 months of fees (standard), except for willful misconduct and IP indemnity which should remain carveout.
- Data residency & PHI: If Fluxa requires EU PHI isolation, we need to surface costs and timeline for Private deployment. Recommend including an Exhibit D that lists controls and milestone dates for a Private turn-up; otherwise, accept Hosted with written SLA exclusions.
- Subprocessors: their requested list includes some partners we treat as infra sub-processors — we can share an abbreviated list but need an NDA addendum before full disclosure.
- Insurance: ask for certificate of insurance with minimum limits; propose Redwood's standard 1M/3M as baseline; confirm if Fluxa requires 5M.
- Payment & PO: Net 60 can be accommodated for strategic healthcare deals but requires Finance approval and a 30-day revenue holdback flag in our billing system. Marissa, note: we'll need a billing contact and PO number before invoicing.

Please see km_fluxa_initial_comments.pdf for line-by-line notes and suggested language. I recommend we prepare two commercial pathways for Jonas to present: (A) Hosted + Exhibit D (shorter time-to-value, limited residency guarantees) or (B) Private deployment (longer procurement & onboarding, higher up-front cost).

LMK if you want me to draft redline text for the liability and indemnity clauses — I can get that to you by Monday afternoon.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: km_fluxa_initial_comments.pdf (line-by-line legal notes and suggested clause alternatives)

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@fluxahealth.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: Avery Cole <avery.cole@fluxahealth.com>, legal@fluxahealth.com
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fluxa Health — MSA + Order Form kickoff / initial redlines

Jonas / team — thanks for the quick intake. We reviewed your note and appreciate the decision-path options. A few answers and asks from procurement: 

- Procurement lead: Priya Shah (me). Net 60 is our standard for vendor payments. If Redwood requires a fee holdback, we need to understand the dollar impact and any early-payment discounts to offset.
- Indemnity: Fluxa Legal prefers Vendor indemnity for third-party claims that arise from Redwood's systems (e.g., data leakage), but can consider mutual indemnity for IP claims. We'll mark our preference in a counterparty redline if you can provide suggested language.
- PO and onboarding: we'll submit a PO once terms are agreed; in the meantime, please send bank wiring instructions, W9 (or W8 if required), and a vendor setup packet.
- Residency: Fluxa is prioritizing EU residency for PHI. Can Redwood supply a short summary of differences in timeline and cost between Hosted with Exhibit D vs Redwood Private (VPC)? We need this to present to our security and legal committees on Wednesday.

We can do the kickoff call on Wed 19 May at 09:00 PT if that works for your team — agenda: 1) confirm commercial pathway, 2) procurement checklist (PO, insurance, COI), 3) timeline-to-production & residency implications.

Thanks,
Priya Shah
Sr. Manager, Procurement
Fluxa Health

Attachments referenced: none in this reply (will upload counterparty redline after your suggested language)
